lines.text: 2.Urban Settlements
Urban settlement in a developed country
Types of Urban Settlement
There are four main types of urban
settlements and these are;
Town:A town is larger than a village but
smaller than a city. It provides higher level
of services such as bank,post office,
hospitalandschool.Atownhasapopulation
of10,000to20,000people.
Atown ofadevelopingcountry
City: A city is greater in size than a town and has more specialized functions like commercial
centers, housing societies, colleges, universities, recreational centers and transportation.
Populationofcitiesrangesfrom1 lacto10lacs.
Conurbation: This is made up of several towns joined together but each town still maintains its
identity. Such as Rawalpindi-Islamabad.
Megalopolis: This is the largest type of Urban settlement. Areas larger than cities are-
megalopolis. Usually its population is about more than 10 million. Karachi, Calcutta, Mumbai,
New York are itsexamples.
